description.default: Two kernel-side tools for the SiYuan agent and external MCP clients: download a web file or base64 payload into workspace assets, and upload an asset to any URL (raw or multipart body, {{secrets}} credential references). Traffic goes through the kernel proxy and approval flow; credentials stay in SiYuan's secret store, never in the chat or logs.
description.zh_CN: 为思源 Agent 与外部 MCP 客户端提供上传/下载两个内核工具：把网络文件或 base64 内容存入工作空间附件；把附件上传到指定链接（表单/原始体、{{secrets}} 凭据引用）。流量走内核网络代理与审批流，凭据存于思源密钥库，不进对话与日志。
